# SOP-02 Log (fixture)

### Step 1. Open the day file

Create the day file for the current date if it does not exist, and never move or rename an earlier day file.

### Step 2. Choose the project alias

Pick the project alias that owns the work. When two projects could own it, tag the entry with the lower confidence value.

### Step 3. Write the entry

Write one entry per unit of work. Keep the narrative short, past tense, and free of message bodies.
